title: Newsletter module settings
description: Operator settings of the newsletter module. Relay passwords are never settings: they live in the module's Secrets (docs/email-policy.md).

from_address.description: From address of campaigns; its domain must carry the SPF/DKIM/DMARC records for the bulk relay.

x-can.not_applied: it is configured inside the application, and can-core does not write it

double_opt_in.description: Require a confirmation click before the first campaign. Turn off only for imports that already carry recorded consent.

x-can.not_applied: it is configured inside the application, and can-core does not write it

relay.description: shared: the company's transactional relay. bulk: a separate bulk relay (recommended once lists grow), so campaign complaints cannot hurt support and invoice mail.

x-can.not_applied: it is configured inside the application, and can-core does not write it

subscribe_from_forms.description: Form ids whose submissions subscribe the sender when they ticked the newsletter field.
